tool_schemas.name: get_transcripts
tool_schemas.description: Extracts and returns a transcript for the requested YouTube video by accepting a YouTube URL or raw video ID, normalizing/resolving it to a video ID, fetching transcript segments in the requested language, storing the video metadata/transcript, and returning the transcript formatted either as a continuous text block or with automatic paragraph breaks when enableParagraphs is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when url is missing/empty or when unknown parameters are provided; raises NOT_FOUND when the URL/ID cannot be resolved to a video or no transcript exists for the requested lang. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to request transcript extraction and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_videos
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored videos with optional filtering by status or YouTube video ID. Returns a paginated result set ordered by most recently updated first; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

youtube_video_id.description: Filter by the normalized YouTube video id stored on the video record.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_video
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single video by internal id. Returns the video record if found; refuses unknown ids.

tool_schemas.name: update_video
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a video, including lifecycle status transitions. Refuses transitions that are not allowed by the video lifecycle (no skipping or resurrecting deleted videos).

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

channel_id.description: Optional channel id override if known.

duration_seconds.description: Optional duration in seconds if known.

tool_schemas.name: list_transcript_tracks
tool_schemas.description: Lists transcript tracks with optional filtering by video, language, or status. Returns a paginated result set; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

lang.description: Filter by exact language code stored on the track (e.g. 'en', 'ja').

status.description: Filter by transcript track lifecycle status.

is_auto_generated.description: Filter by whether the track is auto-generated.

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update_transcript_track
tool_schemas.description: Updates a transcript track, including driving allowed lifecycle status transitions (e.g. re-fetch by moving from failed/unavailable/available to fetching). Refuses invalid transitions and refuses setting available without corresponding transcript content managed by the server.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

failure_reason.description: Reason for failure or unavailability (stored when status is failed/unavailable).

source.description: Transcript source identifier (e.g. upstream provider tag) when applicable.

is_auto_generated.description: Whether this track is auto-generated, when known.

metadata.name: YouTube Transcript Server
metadata.description: This backend stores YouTube video metadata and extracted transcripts per language, plus a job log of transcript extraction requests. The main workflow is: accept a get_transcripts request (url/id + optional lang + formatting option), normalize/resolve the video id, fetch and store transcript segment
